title: Carl Icahn: "I Fired 12 Floors of People"
summary: A short clip in which Carl Icahn tells the story of his first activist investment and of firing 12 floors of people, arguing activism need not be short term.
why: Used as an anecdote in layoff and cost-cutting debates: the company supposedly never noticed what the fired staff had done.

quote.text: Classic Carl Icahn story about firing a building full of people and never discovering what they did
